name: Inwai Saimin Seitaiin ~Midara na Funin Chiryou Hitozuma Haramase Massage~
original_name: 淫猥催眠整体院～淫らな不妊治療 人妻孕ませマッサージ～
source:
There is a modest clinic located at the end of a modest shopping street. However, the clinic has a secret,  any woman can relax not only her body, but also the depths of her soul.

Today, beautiful women visit the clinic for the irresistibly comfortable "dismantling. The practitioner uses hypnosis! The beautiful women become puppets after tasting the deep pleasures of hypnosis. 

Azusa Akagi, is lonely because she struggles to to have children with her loving husband. She reads a magazine article about an eccentric fertility treatment written by a reporter named Mei Matsubara and becomes intrigued.

The clinic that offered the treatment was located in the immediate neighborhood. With a light heart, Azusa knocks on the door. She wonders how long she can love her husband now that she knows true pleasure...

[From [url=http://iranko.com/triumph/saimin02/]official site[/url]]
translation:
在一条朴素的购物街的尽头有一家朴素的诊所。然而，诊所有一个秘密，任何女人不仅可以放松自己的身体，还可以放松她的灵魂深处。

今天，美女们来到诊所进行令人难以抗拒的舒适“拆解”。治疗师使用催眠术！美女们在品尝到催眠的深层快感后，变成了木偶。

赤木梓很孤独，因为她很难与深爱的丈夫生孩子。她读到杂志上一篇由松原梅 (Mei Matsubara) 记者撰写的关于奇怪的生育治疗的文章，并产生了兴趣。

提供治疗的诊所位于附近。梓心情轻松地敲了敲门。她想知道既然她知道了真正的快乐，她还能爱她的丈夫多久……
